# Android Gambatte 0.5.0-netlink / 77f2567

These four unmodified official Libretro archives provide the Game Boy and
Game Boy Color core. `provenance.json` records their original URLs, archive and
payload hashes, ELF ABIs, system-only runtime dependencies and exact source.
`COPYING` retains the GPL-2.0 license; corresponding source is linked by immutable
commit and archive SHA-256. The inspected Android recipe is linked there too.
This is provenance for upstream binaries, not a reproduced NDK build claim.

Broomm downloads this reviewed version only after explicit setup. Runtime URLs
must pin the retained artifact commit; never use Buildbot's rolling `latest`.
Existing cores and build-specific states stay intact until explicit setup.
